scope: One continuous tape through the two shell eyelets; two sewn returns

tape.mass_basis: MIL-DTL5038K2016 TableIII; conditional on conforming, conditioned stock, not wet/contaminated assembly

thread.mass_basis: Retained engineering stitching allowance, not a manufacturer maximum or new lower mass claim

seams.stitch: 301 lockstitch, same selected thread in needle and bobbin
seams.instruction: Fold each tape end lengthwise at the eyelet and through its 30 mm overlap. Thread the folded end through both rounded passages around the fixed post. Sew the return to the same strap with one 24 x 3 mm box and both diagonals. Keep the rest of the strap flat. Inspect edges and stitches; measure seam and anchor strength before use.
